content:
To view NAT logs, do the following:
1. In the Google Cloud console, go to the Logs Explorer page.
Go to Logs Explorer (https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query)
To see all NAT logs, in the Log name menu, select Cloud NAT Gateway.
To see logs for only one region, in the Log name menu, select Cloud NAT
Gateway, and then slide the cursor right to select a region.
To see logs for only one gateway, in the Log name menu, select Cloud NAT
Gateway, and then slide the cursor right to select a region. Slide the cursor
right again to select a single gateway.
Alternatively, enter the following expression into the query editor:
Console
(#console)
gcloud  (#gcloud)
Console
(#console)
gcloud  (#gcloud)
You can configure the export of logs-based metrics (/logging/docs/logs-based-metrics) for
resource logs.
